scope.engine: Actual Board,MoveBudget policy6,createJourney123,Eco121 and explicit native ability effects;100% shell-free Journey attempts.
scope.primary: Manual engine condition with immediate blocked-cause feedback, native U1 coach, earned Focus and dead-end warning. No activated companion or ownership model.
scope.experimental: Hide last-error cause; fully loaned nova/hoot/orbit trio; bypass pacing-energy reservation. No native economy adjustment is implied.
scope.terminalClassification: After each action: solved,budget exhausted,give-up,administrative attempt cap,then availability/utility/day cap. A positive-budget open attempt alone is horizon-censored. Failure feedback now occurs immediately.
scope.cueAssumption: Displayed cause is temporarily recognized with certainty; no initial learning bonus. Structured visible pieces/keys/relations are already identified.
scope.solverBoundary: Bounded policy has no solver. Only explicit native help/talent activation can expose certified information; separate oracle certification is never injected into policy search.
scope.timingLimit: Legacy five-rule duration formula retained, including unused shell term, as an uncalibrated timing assumption; report common-rule knowledge separately.
exclusions: No rendering,visual perception,motor behavior,emotion,comprehension or human retention measurement
New1.23 inspection teaching/navigation/HUD are not simulated
No ownership/acquisition/equipment,stock powers,ads,purchases,social systems or Android persistence
Tactical chapter unchanged and not rerun in this protocol
